description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kottapola, Galigamuwa D/S Division,Kegalle District - Cad. Map No. 610033 (7713)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries for specific parcels of land (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral map references, and location details across different villages and districts) where title particulars have been expunged. The content falls under "LANDS" section and involves land title settlement matters, which directly corresponds to Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related administrative matters.
